title: [Bug Fix] #251: Handle GetUserName TryFunction failure during OAuth validation
summary: Fixed OAuth2 SMTP authentication to properly handle token parsing failures by consuming the TryFunction return value, preventing raw errors from being shown to users instead of the authentication-failed message.
key_points: CheckOAuth2Authentication now uses the GetUserName TryFunction result and shows AuthenticationFailedMsg when token parsing fails
GetOAuth2Credentials now raises CouldNotAuthenticateErr when parsing fails, instead of continuing with an empty user name
Raw runtime parse errors are no longer shown to users
Adds a regression test for an unparseable token in SMTP Account Auth Tests
